$comment: Lifecycle facts read by hand where no infobox or Wikidata property states them. Steps are a timeline: for one item, facts and their steps are listed oldest first and the last step is the current state. reviewedAt is when the cited revision was retrieved. Wikipedia entries (CC BY-SA 4.0) carry only the status, its date and the article revision they were read from; no article text is copied. wikidata entries (CC0) record a judgement read from the item's own statements at the cited revision. An entry whose qid is "geonames:<id>" is a GeoNames placemark (src/tools/placemark-status.mjs). gem-gnpt entries join a facility (or a placemark) to tracker units by unit id when names or positions differ. Check-only registers (IAEA RRDB, BASE, ASNR) chose which articles to read and are never cited here. duplicates: Wikidata items that are one facility; the kept item stands for both. notFacilities: items that are not sites (vessels, single test events), left out of every set. dismantlingReviewed: prose statements of a completed dismantling or delicensing (wikipedia.mjs dismantlingStatements), or of a started one (decommissioningStarts), that were read and do not speak for the row (a sister reactor or an earlier plant on the site, one structure such as a cooling tower, an announcement); every other completed statement on a row that is not DECOMMISSIONED, and every started statement on a row still PERMANENT_SHUTDOWN, stays open in the report for the weekly refresh's reviewer. A geonames:<id> key reviews a statement for that placemark only.
